title: Moscow Parking Occupancy Dataset
description:
5.17 million half-hourly occupancy observations for 213 municipal car parks in Moscow, continuous since 31 March 2025 and refreshed weekly.

Long, dense, public parking-occupancy series are rare: most published work on occupancy prediction still relies on the UCI Parking Birmingham set, which covers October to December 2016 only. This one is longer, denser and still growing.

Files. occupancy_YYYY-MM.parquet, one row per car park per 30-minute slot (time in UTC, parking_id, free_spaces, free_handicapped_spaces, occupancy_rate); parking_spots.parquet, static metadata for 213 lots with coordinates, declared capacity and a feed_silent flag.

Known quirks are documented, not cleaned away: occupancy_rate is negative in 19,785 rows (0.38%) from a pre-2026 collector bug; 48 of 213 lots report a constant zero free spaces because the city registered them but publishes no occupancy; the accessible-space counter exceeds declared capacity in 131,639 rows. Full detail in the README.

Collected from publicly accessible Moscow Department of Transport parking data.
